current: Terfenol-D changes length in a magnetic field more than any other room-temperature material.
corrected: Terfenol-D has the largest magnetostriction of any alloy at room temperature.
reason: Ferromagnetic shape-memory alloys such as Ni-Mn-Ga reach field-induced strains of several percent at room temperature, far more than Terfenol-D's ~0.2%. Its record holds for magnetostriction among alloys, not for every material.
source: Wikipedia 'Terfenol-D'; literature on Ni-Mn-Ga ferromagnetic shape-memory alloys

reason: Bee venom is a peptide/enzyme mixture; the idea that bee stings are formic acid is a popular myth. Formic acid occurs notably in formicine ants and nettle hairs.
source: Wikipedia 'Formic acid' (natural occurrence: ants of subfamily Formicinae, stinging nettles); bee venom composition reviews (melittin, apamin, phospholipase A2)

current: Formic acid is the sting in ant bites.
corrected: "Formic acid is the sting in many ant bites and nettles."
reason: Only some ants (Formicinae) use formic acid; many ant stings (e.g. fire ants) are alkaloid or protein venoms, so the unqualified claim is misleading.
source: Wikipedia 'Formic acid'; 'Formicinae' (only formicine ants spray formic acid; fire ants use alkaloid venom)

current: Urea was the first organic compound made from inorganic starting materials.
corrected: "Wöhler's 1828 urea synthesis was a famous early case of making an organic compound from inorganic starting materials."
reason: Calling it the 'first' is a textbook myth. Wöhler had already made oxalic acid, an organic compound, from cyanogen in 1824. The 1828 urea synthesis is famous, but it was not strictly the first.
source: Ramberg, Ambix 47 (2000) 170; Wöhler's 1824 oxalic acid synthesis from cyanogen (Wikipedia: Wöhler synthesis, Friedrich Wöhler)

current: "ADP + phosphate -> ATP (ATP synthase, driven by respiration)"
corrected: "ADP + phosphate -> ATP + H2O (ATP synthase, driven by respiration)"
reason: Phosphorylation of ADP is a condensation that releases water; without H2O the equation is unbalanced (H and O).
source: Standard biochemistry (Berg, Biochemistry); atom count ADP C10H15N5O10P2 + H3PO4 = ATP C10H16N5O13P3 + H2O

corrected: "Mainly DNA; small amounts in tRNA as ribothymidine."
reason: Thymine also occurs in RNA (tRNA T-loop), so 'DNA only' is overstated.

current: Vision starts when one photon straightens a single bond in retinal.
corrected: "Vision starts when one photon flips a cis double bond in retinal to trans."
reason: The photoisomerization happens at the C11=C12 double bond, not a single bond. The entry's own electronSharing text correctly says a double bond.
source: Standard biochemistry (Wald; 11-cis-retinal to all-trans-retinal photoisomerization at C11=C12)
